question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**menace**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate title of the given passage is 'Nutrition in children'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the fifth blank is 'menace'.
 
• It means 'a danger or threat'. (ख़तरा या ख़तरे की आशंका)
 
 
• *Example: The new road is a **menace** to everyone’s safety.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **solace**: a person or thing that makes you feel better or happier when you are sad or disappointed. (उदासी या निराशा के क्षणों में तसल्‍ली देने वाला व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु; सांत्‍वनाकारी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु)
 
• **balance**: a situation in which different or opposite things are of equal importance, size, etc. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें विभिन्न प्रकार की या विपरीत वस्तुओं का आकार, महत्व आदि समान होता है; संतुलन, संतुलन की स्थिति)
 
• **embrace**: to put your arms around somebody as a sign of love, happiness, etc. [(प्रेम, प्रसन्‍नता आदि से) आलिंगन करना, गले लगाना]

 
 
 

**Correct Passage:__*** The most urgent areas of attention and immediate action are nutrition, health and education of children, whose well-being reflects the health of the society and caring outlook of the polity. Since the causes of malnutrition of children are many, like exploding population, bias against the female child, weak and suffering mothers, the remedy calls for ‘care of the mother and care by mother’, besides, an effective control over population explosion. Ignorance on what food should be taken is another contributory factor that results in malnutrition among women and children. The implementation of various schemes to fight the **menace** of malnutrition and undernourishment of children requires planning, co-ordination and monitoring by high-powered bodies right down to the village level.*
